GPTR-F-001-S126.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S126.description: Implement the core enforcement logic that evaluates every incoming GPTReader query against the allowlist schema, including collection access, field-level restrictions, operator validation, and query limits before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S127.title: API Enforcement Hook Integration
GPTR-F-001-S127.description: Integrate the allowlist enforcement engine into the GPTReader Azure Function request lifecycle, ensuring validation occurs before any database interaction and is mandatory for all entry points.

GPTR-F-001-S128.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S128.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests validating allowlist enforcement across valid and invalid queries, including boundary cases (field injection, operator misuse, over-limit queries).

GPTR-F-001-S129.title: End-to-End Enforcement Validation via SIT Runner
GPTR-F-001-S129.description: Extend GPT SIT runner scenarios to include scope enforcement validation, ensuring real GPT-driven queries cannot bypass allowlist constraints under autonomous execution.
